messages:
maria_sec: Auditor asked for evidence of emergency KMS key access + RBAC change tickets tied to incident response drills. Can we assemble exports?

isaac_sre: We have IAM role change logs + KMS access events. Which time range do they want? They mentioned 'last 12 months' in the brief but called out the 2025-01-12 drill specifically.

maria_sec: They specifically asked for 'chain of custody' for key material and emergency access justification for service accounts. Need mapping between CMKs and service accounts. @alex_dev can you pull key policy snapshots and rotation history?

alex_dev: On it. Will export key policy snapshots + rotation history from AWS KMS. Dropping to S3 as signed artifacts. Command I used for a snapshot:```aws kms get-key-policy --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abc-123 --policy | jq .```

auditor_jane: For clarity: we need evidence that emergency access was approved and logged (ticket + approver), the KMS decrypt/logs showing use, and whether key rotation occurred post-incident. PDFs + CSVs are fine. Also prefer indicators tying logs -> ticket ids.

isaac_sre: Ticket numbers: SEC-4332 and SEC-4410 are the emergency approvals. I'll attach the incident runbook snapshot and the Slack approval thread. Also exporting CloudTrail events for the timeframe: `s3://redwood-evidence/audit/cloudtrail/2025/01/12/`

maria_sec: For RBAC changes we need before/after RoleBinding diffs in EKS and GCP IAM binding diffs. I'll pull PR diffs, k8s audit logs, and IAM policy snapshots.

alex_dev: k8s audit snippet for the change (redacted):
```
{ "verb": "create", "user": "ops-bot", "resource": "rolebinding", "name": "emergency-access-2025-01-12" }
```
I'll include mapping PR hash -> deploy id and the pipeline run url.

auditor_jane: Also need hash of the remediation binary if a signed build was deployed as part of mitigation. A release tag + signed checksum is acceptable.

isaac_sre: :thumbsup: I'll add release tag `v2025.1.13` and link to the signed asset (SHA256).

maria_sec: One more ask: provide the list of principals with `kms:Decrypt` and KMS Admin role during the incident window. We'll export IAM groups/roles and redact personal emails.

alex_dev: Heads up: some exports will include PII and service-account emails. We'll mark the artifacts as 'sensitive' in the evidence manifest and share via secure artifact link.

deploy-bot: Export job completed: s3://redwood-evidence/packaged/evidence-2025-03-04-1765432100.tar.gz (access: audit-only)

auditor_jane: Excellent. Can you confirm the timeline of who approved emergency access? I need approver id + approval timestamp. If you can include correlating Slack message IDs and ticket transition events that's ideal.

maria_sec: I'll produce a crosswalk CSV with columns: ticket, approver, approver_email(redacted), approval_ts, key_id, cloudtrail_event_id, slack_message_id, pr_hash. Will upload to the secure manifest and notify you.

isaac_sre: FYI I'll also note whether any CVEs were referenced in the incident (we had a vuln triage on CVE-2025-0456 and mitigations were applied). Will link vuln tracker entries.

auditor_jane: That should cover it. Once we have the crosswalk + signed artifacts + CloudTrail slices, we can close the evidence request. Thanks everyone.
